status: draft for the owner's edit (slice (f) lane, 2026-09-06)
artist_scope: none (Tier 3: code-driven; the most-boned Tier-3 rig, 56 bones)
character_sheet: A four-block hybrid warrior: articulated legs (foot, shin, calf, knee guard, thigh per side), a spined back, a shield on the right arm and a cannon on the left. Point-blank it hammers with a knockback swing; at range it shoulder-fires laser balls, upgraded to an explosive variant beyond eight blocks. In a fight the shield arm pumps up and down (which also flags 'shielding' client-side) and the cannon arm lifts into a firing pose; at rest both arms hang.

labels.head: head (turns with the gaze at 2/3 rate)
labels.leftupperarm: left upper arm (the cannon follows it)

groups.name: legs
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) x limbSwingAmount while limbSwingAmount > 0.1; plus fixed offsets (calf +0.175, knee guard +0.63, thigh -0.175)
groups.plain: each leg swings as one unit (foot pieces, shin, calf, knee guard, thigh) — left against right — around a slightly bent standing pose
groups.math: walk = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t*0.5)*pi*0.15*amount : 0; left*.xRot = walk (+offset); right*.xRot = -walk (+offset)

groups.name: shield_arm
groups.amplitude: |cos| x 0.785 + 0.75 rad while attacking (a pump between 0.75 and 1.54 rad, 30 ticks per pump); 0 at rest; with per-bone offsets
groups.plain: in a fight the whole right arm and shield pump up and down; when the pump passes a third of its amplitude the client raises the SHIELDING flag
groups.math: arm = attacking ? |cos(rad(t % 360) * 6)| * 0.7854 + 0.75 : 0; rightsholder.xRot = -arm; sheildbase/sheildtip.xRot = -arm + 1.047; rightsholdergaurd/rightupperarm/sholdergaurdtip.xRot = -arm - 0.21; rightlowerarm.xRot = -arm + 1.047; sheildend.xRot = -arm + 1.04

groups.name: cannon_arm
groups.phase: the attacking flag (a pose, not a cycle)
groups.amplitude: cannonAngle = 0.85 rad while attacking, 0 at rest; the cannon assembly translates to follow the upper arm (14 units along its direction)
groups.plain: the left arm lifts the cannon into a firing pose while attacking; the cannon pieces slide with the upper arm's angle
groups.math: c = attacking ? 0.85 : 0; leftsholder.xRot = -c; leftupperarm.xRot = -c - 0.21; cannon*.xRot = -c - 0.7; glow bits -c + 0.17 / +0.08 / 0; cannon parts' y,z = shoulder + (cos, sin)(leftupperarm.xRot) * 14

groups.name: head
groups.plain: the head turns with the gaze at two-thirds rate

behaviour: The twelve back spines, neck, chest, torso, stomach and hips are static.
SHIELDING is written by the client's arm pump (ENT-K-070: the server-side shield gate stays cold) — a state the model produces, not one it reads.
formulas: `ModelRobot4.poseFrom` (ModelRobot4.java:424-532, called from `setupAnim` :418-422; orig ModelRobot4.java:421-500, `render`): (1) the legs — while the walking speed is above a tenth, the cosine of the age in ticks times 0.5, times pi, times 0.15, times the walking speed (up to 27 degrees; orig :421-437): the left foot pieces, shin, calf, knee guard and thigh pitch by that angle and the right ones by its negative, the calves plus 0.175 radians, the knee guards plus 0.63, the thighs minus 0.175 (the standing bend); (2) the head yaws by the head yaw over 1.5, in radians; (3) the shield arm — while attacking, the absolute cosine of (the age modulo 360, in radians, times 6) times 0.7853982, plus 0.75 — a pump between 0.75 and 1.54 radians — else 0, and the client-side shielding flag is raised while that exceeds a third of 0.7853982 (orig :439-451, ENT-K-070): the right shoulder pitches by its negative, the shoulder guard, upper arm and guard tip by its negative minus 0.21, the shield base, shield tip and lower arm by its negative plus 1.047, the shield end by its negative plus 1.04; (4) the cannon arm — 0.85 radians while attacking, else 0 (orig :460-474): the left shoulder pitches by its negative, the upper arm by its negative minus 0.21, the cannon base, muzzle, four plates and ammunition drum by its negative minus 0.7, the glow segments by its negative plus 0.17, 0.17, 0.08, 0.08 and 0; (5) the cannon follow — every cannon part's pivot moves to the left shoulder's pivot plus 14 units along (cos, sin) of the upper arm's pitch, in y and z (orig :475-500), a POSITION write. At rest the arms hang (the cannon parts sit 14 units along the -0.21-radian upper arm) and only the legs move. The GeckoLib hook is the same (Robot4GeoReplacement.java:40-121, the follow through `moveTo`).
